summary: Russian forces reported destroying a Ukrainian troop group near Konotopivka, while Ukrainian officials reported a drone attack in Kherson causing civilian casualties. Ukrainian robotic systems completed over 16,600 logistics missions in June, and Russian air defenses reportedly intercepted 376 drones. Estonian proposals to restrict IOC access to EU funding were also reported.
key_points: Russian southern group destroyed a Ukrainian troop group in the Konotopivka area (Source: @tass_agency/384623).
Ukrainian robotic systems completed over 16,600 logistics and evacuation missions in June (Source: @DeepStateUA/23627).
Russian air defenses intercepted 376 Ukrainian drones over Russian regions (Source: @tass_agency/384640).
A drone attack in Kherson caused injuries to two civilian women (Source: @UkraineNow/82531).
Estonia proposed stripping the IOC of EU funding over Russia's sports return (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31512).
Ukrainian President Zelenskyy announced investigations into ammunition depot breaches (Source: @UkraineNow/82538).
Drone attacks were reported in multiple regions including Kherson and Zaporizhzhia (Source: @kpszsu/67884).
A fire at an oil refinery in Krasnodar Krai was caused by drone debris (Source: @tass_agency/384631).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces continue to employ drone warfare extensively, with air defenses reporting interception of hundreds of UAVs. Ukrainian forces are increasingly utilizing robotic systems for logistics operations, demonstrating adaptation to combat conditions. Civilian casualties from drone attacks indicate ongoing risks to non-combatants in conflict zones.
sections.regional_response: Estonia proposed restricting IOC access to EU funding regarding Russia's sports participation. Polish-Ukrainian relations remain strained over historical issues, with Polish President emphasizing concerns about Ukrainian symbols. International discussions continue regarding potential production of Patriot systems in Poland due to security concerns.
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian robotic systems show significant operational growth with over 16,600 missions completed in June. Russian air defense capabilities demonstrated through interception of 376 drones. Civilian infrastructure remains vulnerable to drone attacks across multiple regions. Historical and diplomatic tensions persist between regional partners.
